競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: ポスト・ホールディングス

relations.text: 業務用食品事業の最大顧客がSyscoとUS Foods(2社で同事業売上の41.2%)
relations.text_en: Sysco and US Foods are the largest customers of its foodservice segment, 41.2% of its sales

source.label: Post 10-K(2024年提出)
source.quote: The largest customers of our Foodservice segment, Sysco and US Foods, accounted for 41.2% of the segment's net sales in fiscal 2024.

companies.name: ママズ・クリエーションズ

relations.text: Syscoの子会社Crown I Enterprisesの資産のほぼ全てを1,750万ドルで取得
relations.text_en: Bought substantially all assets of Sysco subsidiary Crown I Enterprises for $17.5 million

source.label: Mama's Creations 10-Q(2025年9月)
source.quote: a full-service manufacturer of value-added proteins and ready-to-eat meals and a wholly-owned, subsidiary of Sysco Corporation for $ 17.5 million in cash

relations.text: 40年以上にわたりSyscoと物流契約を結ぶ重要な取引先
relations.text_en: Has had distribution agreements with Sysco for over 40 years

source.label: Aramark 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: Our relationship with Sysco is important to our operations, and we have had distribution agreements in place for over 40 years.

companies.name: GENレストラン・グループ

relations.text: Syscoのロサンゼルス子会社から3年間食材を購入する契約
relations.text_en: Signed a three-year agreement to buy food products from Sysco Los Angeles

source.label: GEN Restaurant Group 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: we entered into an agreement with Sysco Los Angeles, Inc., or Sysco, to purchase certain food products for a period of three years.

relations.text: 主要な食材の仕入先がSysco
relations.text_en: Sysco is its key food product supplier

source.label: Pinstripes 10-K(2024年提出)
source.quote: we have established excellent long-term relationships with our key food product supplier, Sysco Corporation ("Sysco")

companies.name: ブラック・ロック・コーヒー・バー

relations.text: 2025年の仕入れの89%を占める3社の一社がSysco
relations.text_en: Sysco is one of three suppliers making up 89% of its 2025 purchases

source.label: Black Rock Coffee Bar 10-K(2026年提出)
source.quote: 89% of our purchases came from three suppliers Sysco Corporation, Too Sweet and Royal Coffee

companies.name: ONEグループ・ホスピタリティ

relations.text: 食材でSyscoへの依存が大きい(他の仕入先は各15%以下)
relations.text_en: Relies heavily on Sysco for food; no other food supplier exceeds 15% of purchases

source.label: ONE Group Hospitality 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: no supplier of food, excluding Sysco, accounts for more than 15% of our total food and beverage purchases

companies.name: ファーマー・ブラザーズ

relations.text: Farmer Brothersが10-Kで、競合の業務用食品卸としてSyscoを挙げる
relations.text_en: Farmer Brothers names Sysco among wholesale foodservice distributors it competes with

source.label: Farmer Brothers 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: wholesale foodservice distributors such as Sysco Corporation and US Foods Holding Corp.

companies.name: グローバル・インダストリー・プロダクツ

relations.text: 主な競合としてSyscoを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Sysco among its primary competitors

source.label: Global Industry Products 10-K(2026年提出)
source.quote: Our primary competitors are BradyPlus, Sysco, and Shetakis Wholesalers.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
